plan: My value is $39. To maximize profit, I should bid below my value but high enough to outbid others. Bidding exactly $39 risks zero profit if I win. Bids above $39 are dominated as they guarantee a loss. A bid of $38.9 maximizes my chance of winning while ensuring a small profit if successful.

Given my value of $27, I should aim to bid less than this to ensure profit if I win. Bidding exactly $27 means zero profit if I win, and bidding more results in a loss. Dominated bids are those above $27, as they guarantee a loss. I will bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a competitive chance of winning. A bid of $26.9 balances these factors, as it gives me a small profit if I win while minimizing the chance of overbidding relative to my value.
